text:
sec-bot: [SECURITY ADVISORY] High-severity parsing vuln in libproxy-httpx v3.8.0 (CVE-2024-XXXX). Affected: Dedicated and Private runtime images built before 2024-07-01. Possible request smuggling and service crashes. Immediate actions required.

sec-bot: ACTIONS:
1) Rebuild runtime images against libproxy-httpx >= 3.8.1 and publish new runtime tags.
2) Rotate long-lived connector/service-account keys issued before 2024-07-01.
3) Apply temporary WAF/header-normalization rule at edge for unknown/malformed headers.
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/sec/runbooks/libhttpx-3-8-0 (internal)

marta: Is Hosted API affected?

oliver: Hosted fleet already pulled patched base this morning. Hosted = NOT impacted. Dedicated clusters and customer Private images that used the old base are at risk. I'm enumerating cluster images now.

ashley: Detection snippets for infra teams:
```
# list pods with old base image
kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath="{range .items}{.metadata.namespace} {.spec.containers[*].image}\n{end}" | grep libproxy-httpx || true
# find images on hosts
ssh host "docker images | grep libproxy-httpx || true"
```

marta: Ops, please prioritize connector key rotation for connectors into customer VPCs/on-prem. @ops-bot schedule please.

ops-bot: Scheduled job rotate-connector-secrets-171849 for us-west-2 + eu-west-1. Start: 2024-04-05T02:00Z. Runbook: rotate-171849. Will post per-region completion.

jonah: On-call plan: 2-hour sprints. Leads: @ashley (lead), @oliver (platform), @marta (sec verification). Update thread every 30m. Escalate to @vp-security if customer impact.

emily: I'll prep status page; hold public advisory until we confirm Dedicated status.

sec-bot: Patch build example:
```
docker build -t registry.redwood.ai/runtime:patch-171849 --build-arg LIBHTTPX_VERSION=3.8.1 .
docker push registry.redwood.ai/runtime:patch-171849
# CI job: .circleci/patch-httpx.yml
```

ashley: Kicking off rolling updates for dedicated pools: redwood-dedicated-{a,b,c}. Rolling strategy: maxUnavailable=1 per region. Monitor with:
```
kubectl -n <ns> rollout status deploy/inference
kubectl -n <ns> get pods -l app=inference -o wide
```

ops-bot: Connectors rotated in us-west-2 + eu-west-1; old keys revoked. Remaining regions: ap-south-1, ap-southeast-1.

marta: Legal + CS: draft advisory for Dedicated customers. Wait to send until ~80% clusters patched unless customer-visible issues appear. Notify affected account teams immediately.

oliver: Acknowledged. We'll hold outbound comms until 80% patched; internal heads-up to account teams is fine.

sec-bot: Private/on-prem customers: rebuild base image with libproxy-httpx 3.8.1 and restart inference services within 24h. If you manage Private installs, contact customer infra leads now.

emily: Patch status: 45% Dedicated clusters updated. Next update in 30m.

ops-bot: Reminder: if you see anomalous header parse errors or 4xx/5xx spikes, tag logs with "libhttpx-incident" and escalate to #incidents. Quick grep:
```
journalctl -u inference | grep -iE "header parse|request smuggle|httpx" || true
```

ashley: us-west-2 rollout complete, smoke tests green. Proceeding to -b.

ops-bot: Connector rotation complete for us-west-2 + eu-west-1. Keys revoked and new keys distributed.

marta: Thanks. Keep updates concise. I'll draft post-incident notes once stable.

emily: Final status: 100% affected Dedicated clusters patched at 1718495720. Actions closed; follow-ups: customer advisory, postmortem, update private deploy docs.

sec-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem owner: marta. Timeline & artifacts: https://redwood.internal/sec/incidents/libhttpx-171849 (internal)
